name: MemberCount
description: Shows the number of online members, total members, and users in voice channels on the server - in the member list and tooltip.
summary: Online, total and in-voice member counts in the member list

settings.label: Tooltip
settings.description: Show member count on the server tooltip

settings.label: Member list
settings.description: Show member count in the member list

settings.label: Voice activity
settings.description: Show voice activity with member count in the member list

gaps: Online counts for servers you have not opened: upstream preloads each hovered server's member list to learn its online count; Qord shows "?" until you open the server.
Thread member lists: Qord has no thread member list, so threads use the parent channel's count.
notes: The numbers come from the member list Discord sends (online members in the channel's list, total server members) and from the voice states of channels you can see.
